title: SFrame (RFC 9605): end-to-end encryption of media frames
spec: docs/CALLS.md 'End-to-end encryption', from RFC 9605 alone. Header { kid, ctr }: config byte X K(3) Y C(3); values below 8 inline, others in the fewest big-endian bytes (length minus one in K or C), key id before counter; decode refuses non-minimal encodings and cut headers. derive(suite, kid, base_key): sframe_secret = HKDF-Extract(empty salt, base_key); key and salt = HKDF-Expand with the labels 'SFrame 1.0 Secret key ' / 'SFrame 1.0 Secret salt ' followed by the 8-byte big-endian key id and the 2-byte cipher suite id, Nk and Nn bytes. Suites 0x0004 AES_128_GCM_SHA256_128 and 0x0005 AES_256_GCM_SHA512_128. Nonce = salt XOR big-endian counter; AAD = header + metadata; frame = header + ciphertext + 16-byte tag. Key::encrypt/decrypt, decrypt by key id, and Sender, which never reuses a counter (CounterExhausted at the end). Matches the RFC's Appendix C.1 header rows and C.3 vector for 0x0004; changed frames, metadata or headers fail authentication; unknown key ids are reported. AES-GCM and HKDF from ring.
